name: SPIDER MAKER
summary: Filament brand on Amazon selling nylon carbon-fibre ($23.70/kg in 1 kg) and matte TPU ('SpiderFlex', $90/kg in 0.5 kg). Sold by Phrozen's own Amazon seller account; whether Phrozen owns the brand is not stated.

oem_relationships.notes: The Amazon listing (ASIN B0CCV5S9YP, Manufacturer 'SPIDER MAKER') is sold by Phrozen's seller account 'Phrozen 3D Printer' (id A34XNOS9PNSJKJ, Business Name 'PHROZEN TECH CO., LTD.', Hsinchu), and the first pass found the brand in Phrozen's US store. That makes Phrozen the seller of record only; ownership is not stated, so the parent link is suspected.
